author: KEXP
description: Through poetic country folk, Josiah Flores reflects on family history, individuality, and personal change. Live on KEXP at Noise Pop, the Bay Area-based artist shares a performance of "La Lucha" and more.
title: Josiah Flores performs "La Lucha" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
description:
http://KEXP.ORG presents Josiah Flores performing live at 25th Street Recording in Oakland, California, during Noise Pop 2026. Recorded February 26, 2026.

Songs:
Young, Dumb, & Full Of Beer  00:27
The Names We Changed  03:41
La Lucha  07:29
Prize Of Fame  11:21

Josiah Flores - Guitar, Vocals
